lines.japanese: 香田と別れて、ひとりやってきた地下室。
lines.english: I parted ways with Kouda and came down to the basement alone.

lines.japanese: ＰＭ９時。ナイトクラブ『ヘテロクロミア』には、早くも熱狂が渦巻いていた。
lines.english: Nine p.m. The nightclub Heterochromia was already a vortex of excitement.

lines.japanese: 今日はどうしてこんなに夜が浅いうちから盛りあがっているんだろう。いつもの夜通しパーティーなら、最高潮を迎えるのはもっと遅く。終電も過ぎたあとだ。
lines.english: Why was the place this wild so early? On their usual all-night party schedule, things didn't peak until much later, after the last train had gone.

lines.japanese: 「ＹＯ、成田君。珍しくあんたがやって来たって、受付ボーイに聞いたもんで、ロスの路地裏から飛んできたぜ。御機嫌いかがだい、ファッキンマイメン」
lines.english: “Yo, Narita! Door boy said you showed up for once, so I came flying straight out of a back alley in LA. How's it hanging, my fuckin' man?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、俺はぼちぼちだけど、てかおまえら、もうヤンキー引退したんじゃなかったの」
lines.english: “Can't complain. I thought you guys had retired from being delinquents.”

lines.japanese: 「んなこた誰も言ってねえ。そもそもからしてフレイムバーズは組織じゃない、概念だ。辞める辞めないの二元論で語るようなモンじゃねえんだよ」
lines.english: “Nobody ever said that. To begin with, the Flame Birds aren't an organization. They're a concept. You can't reduce them to some binary question of joining or quitting.”

lines.japanese: また適当なこと言ってんな、黒豚。
lines.english: Making shit up again, Black Pig.

lines.japanese: 「ま、今日はスペシャルだからな」
lines.english: “Besides, tonight's special.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、この騒ぎか。コレは何。今日はどういうパーティーなの」
lines.english: “Oh, you mean this racket? What is it? What kind of party are you throwing?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだい、てっきり知ってて来たのかと思ったぜ。だが、あんたが今日ここへ来た事実を偶然と呼ぶには話が出来すぎてる。こいつはきっと神の思し召しってやつだ」
lines.english: “What, you didn't come because you knew? And yet it's far too perfect to call your arrival tonight a coincidence. Surely, this is the hand of God at work.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。早く質問に答えろよ」
lines.english: “Just answer the question already.”

lines.japanese: 「Ｈｕｈ！　あんたの顔に付いてる二つの玉コロは精巣かい？　俺を急かすよりそっから下を覗きこんだ方が早いぜ」
lines.english: “Huh! Are those two balls on your face testicles? Instead of busting mine, use them to look down there.”

lines.japanese: 黒豚が顎で手すりを示す。相変わらずめんどくせえ豚だな、と呟きながら、吹き抜けになっている下のダンスフロアを覗きこんだ。
lines.english: Black Pig pointed at the railing with his chin. Muttering that the pig was as tiresome as ever, I peered down into the open dance floor below.

lines.japanese: 「せいィ！」
lines.english: “Sei!”
“Whoa...!”

lines.japanese: 群衆の熱気と興奮が、生ぬるい風のように頬を打った。
lines.english: The crowd's heat and excitement struck my cheeks like a lukewarm wind.

lines.japanese: 『入ったー！　バニィ選手のクリーンヒット、がっつり入りましたァー！』
lines.english: “It connects! A clean hit from Bunny, and he buried it!”

lines.japanese: フロアの中央で男と男が睨みあい、その周りを囲む大観衆が狂ったように囃したてている。
lines.english: Two men were glaring at each other in the middle of the floor, surrounded by a huge crowd howling like lunatics.

lines.japanese: 男の一方は上半身裸の金髪マッチョ。対するは、あのハニィＢだかＣだかいう空手使いのチャラ男だった。
lines.english: One was a shirtless, blond muscleman. Facing him was the flashy karate guy called Honey B—or C, or whatever.

lines.japanese: 「なんスか、なんスか、終わりッスかあ？　オイオイ、もっと俺の強さ引きたてちゃってクダサイよォ～」
lines.english: “What is this? What is this? We done already? Come on, make me look a little stronger here!”

lines.japanese: 「あーあー、またケンカかよ、いちいち気の短ぇ連中だな。つか、店員も周りの客も、見てねーで止めろっての」
lines.english: “Oh, for God's sake. Another fight? These guys really do have no patience. And the staff and customers need to quit watching and break it up.”

lines.japanese: 「おっと成田君、気が早い。ガキの殴り合いと、男の果たし合いを、一緒にしないでもらいたい。こいつぁ柳木原一の強者を決める、その名もＹ１グランプリ。あんたは出来ない、知らんぷり」
lines.english: “Not so fast, Narita. Don't confuse a childish brawl with a duel between men. This is the contest to crown Yanagihara's strongest: the Y1 Grand Prix. You can't just ask why and walk by.”

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 『さあ、いよいよ試合は大詰めを迎えてまいりました。Ｙ１グランプリＢリーグ、準々決勝に勝ちすすむのは下馬評通り、鶴岡工業バニィＤか！　あるいは番狂わせ、キラーシャークの山田か！』
lines.english: “The match is entering its final phase! Who will advance to the B League quarterfinals of the Y1 Grand Prix? The favorite, Bunny D of Tsuruoka Technical? Or will Yamada of the Killer Sharks pull off an upset?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、リアルファイト・ショーな」
lines.english: “Oh. A live fight show.”

lines.japanese: 自主格闘大会──と言えば聞こえはいいが、要はただの公開ケンカ祭りだ。
lines.english: An amateur martial-arts tournament sounded respectable enough. In practice, it was a festival of public brawling.

lines.japanese: 「成田隼人、またの名を柳木原最強の皇帝と引きわけた男。あんたも一丁エントリーしちゃあどうだい？」
lines.english: “Hayato Narita—the man who fought the Emperor, Yanagihara's strongest, to a draw. Why don't you throw your hat in the ring?”

lines.japanese: 「くだらねえ。ヤンキー軍団の一等賞になったって嬉しくねえよ、べつに賞金が出るわけでも──」
lines.english: “That's stupid. Why would I care about coming first in a pack of delinquents? It's not like there's prize money—”

lines.japanese: 『そしてそして優勝賞金５万円はいったい誰の手にィー！？』
lines.english: “And who will claim the fifty-thousand-yen grand prize?!”

lines.japanese: 「え、賞金出んの」
lines.english: “Wait. There's prize money?”

lines.japanese: 「イェア、戦闘意欲が湧いたかい、貧乏一家の末っ子さんよ。ここにいるのは誰も彼も、景気の悪い庶民ばかりだ。金でも出なけりゃ始まらないぜ」
lines.english: “Yeah! Feeling that fighting spirit now, baby of the poor family? Everyone here is a broke commoner in a bad economy. Nobody gets started without cash on the table.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、でも……ソレ違法だろ」
lines.english: “Yeah, but... this is illegal.”

lines.japanese: 「ヘイＹＯ、頭の固いＪボーイ。この店の通称を知ってるかい？　人呼んでヘテロ王国大使館。つまりここは治外法権、黄色いサルのルールの外だ。俺らの誇りは取りしまれねえ」
lines.english: “Hey, yo, uptight J-boy. Know what they call this club? The Embassy of the Kingdom of Hetero. That puts us beyond your yellow-monkey laws. Our pride can't be policed.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえらの誇りがどうだろうと、いま警察に踏みこまれたら終わりなことに変わりはねーじゃん」
lines.english: “Whatever you think about your pride, the police raid this place and you're still fucked.”

lines.japanese: 「ザッツライ、だが踏みこまれない。なぜなら俺らの皇帝陛下に、抜かりはない隙はない」
lines.english: “That's right. But they won't raid us. His Imperial Majesty leaves no loose ends and no openings.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そいつ。おまえらの皇帝、どこいんの」
lines.english: “Right, him. Where is your Emperor?”

lines.japanese: 俺は狂乱のフロアを見渡して、鳳翔の長身を探した。
lines.english: I scanned the frenzied floor for Kakeru Ohtori's tall figure.

lines.japanese: 「さあな、今夜は姿を見せずだ。あるいは今頃この街じゅうの、雌ブタ集めて脱がせて抱いて、淫乱ぶり競う裏グランプリ」
lines.english: “Beats me. Hasn't shown his face tonight. Maybe he's somewhere else in the city, stripping and screwing every sow he can round up for a secret grand prix to see which one's the biggest slut.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: いないのか、あいつ。
lines.english: So he wasn't here.

lines.japanese: 階下では、例のチャラ男が相手選手をノックダウンして、歓声を浴びているところだった。
lines.english: Downstairs, the flashy guy had just knocked his opponent down and was basking in the cheers.

lines.japanese: 格闘ショウはブレイクタイムに突入。一息つけたドレッドのリングアナウンサーが階段をのぼってくる。丁度いい、やつに話を聞いてみよう。
lines.english: The fighting show went to break. The dreadlocked ring announcer, finally free for a moment, came up the stairs. Perfect. I'd ask him.

lines.japanese: 「ヤーマン！　来てたのォ、成田っち～」
lines.english: “Ya, man! When'd you get here, Narita?”

lines.japanese: 「おう、おつかれ」
lines.english: “Yo. Nice work.”

lines.japanese: レゲエ野郎がグラスビールを突きだしてきたので、こぶしで乾杯した。
lines.english: The reggae guy held out his beer, and I bumped my fist against the glass in a toast.

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃはは！　あんたが参加してくれンなら、この大会もブリブリにアガっちゃうでしょ！　ウェルカム、ニューカマー。エントリーはお済ませ～？」
lines.english: “Gyahaha! You join in and this tournament's gonna get high as fuck! Welcome, newcomer! You entered yet?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そーゆーんで来たんじゃねンだよ。ちょっとおまえに聞きたいことが──」
lines.english: “I didn't come for that. There's something I wanna ask you—”

lines.japanese: 「だぁ～いじょぶよ！　成田っちクラスの挑戦者なら、突発乱入大歓迎だって！　手続きなんか不要不要！」
lines.english: “Nooo problem! A challenger in your class can storm in whenever he wants. No paperwork, no paperwork!”

lines.japanese: 「だから、違げーんだって。いいから、ちょっと」
lines.english: “That's not why I'm here. Just listen a second.”

lines.japanese: 「なに、なんなの」
lines.english: “What? What is it?”

lines.japanese: このレゲエ野郎はここじゃ結構な有名人（月に何度かＤＪを務めていてＭＣも好評らしい）だから、ただでさえ注目を集めやすい。
lines.english: The reggae guy was something of a celebrity here—apparently he DJed a few times a month and people liked his MC work—so he attracted attention even at the best of times.

lines.japanese: 億劫がって渋るレゲエを、むりやりフロアの隅まで引っぱっていった。
lines.english: He dragged his feet, but I hauled him into a corner of the floor.

lines.japanese: 「悪りい、ちょっと見てもらいたいんだけど」
lines.english: “Sorry. I need you to look at something.”

lines.japanese: 壁と背中で死角を作って、エージのバッグを腹に抱く。
lines.english: I used my body and the wall to block the view, hugging Eiji's bag against my stomach.

lines.japanese: ヘビ革ジャケットの色気付いたガキが通りがかりに覗きこもうとするのを、軽く顎で追いはらってから──
lines.english: A young punk in a snakeskin jacket tried to peek as he went past. I shooed him away with a flick of my chin, then—

lines.japanese: 「専門家の意見を聞かせてほしい」
lines.english: “I need an expert opinion.”

lines.japanese: ──注意深くジッパーを引いていった。
lines.english: —carefully pulled open the zipper.

lines.japanese: 「なーんだよ、どったのコソコソしちゃってェ。ひとには見せられない魔法の粉でも入ってんのォ～？　のゎーんつってブヒャヒャヒャ……」
lines.english: “What's with all the sneaking around? Got some magic powder in there you can't show anyone? Just kiddin', bhyah hah hah—”

lines.japanese: 「ヒャぱァァァァーッ！　ままま、まじでええええええー！」
lines.english: “Hyaaaaaah! A-a-are you fucking serious?!”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ、ばか、でけえ声あげんな」
lines.english: “I-idiot! Keep your voice down.”

lines.japanese: レゲエの大声にヘビ革が振りむいていた。見るな。ふたたび顎で追いはらう。
lines.english: The reggae guy's shout made Snakeskin turn around. Don't look. I chased him away with my chin again.

lines.japanese: 「ったく、注目浴びちゃうだろが。静かにしろ静かに」
lines.english: “Goddammit, you're drawing attention. Quiet. Keep it quiet.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、だって……な、なっ、なななななんつー大量の……あわわわじゅるるるる……」
lines.english: “B-but... th-th-that's so much... Ahh... sluuurp...”

lines.japanese: 「垂らすな。ヨダレを垂らすな」
lines.english: “Don't drool. Quit drooling.”

lines.japanese: 「いっ、いくら！？　グラムいくら？　ねえ、キロ単位で引いてもいい？　アッ、まさか混ぜ物でカサ増やしてないよね？　してないよね、プッシャーは信用商売だもんね、そんな法に反するような真似してないよね！」
lines.english: “H-how much? What's the price per gram? Hey, can I buy it by the kilo? You didn't cut it with anything to bulk it up, did you? You didn't, right? Pushers live on trust. You wouldn't do anything against the law, right?”

lines.japanese: 「落ちつけ。俺は売人じゃねーよ」
lines.english: “Calm down. I'm not a dealer.”

lines.japanese: 「フゥー、分かってるさ。ちょっとしたジョークよ。俺は趣味に関しちゃ、節度とマナーを守ってるんだ。こんなことぐらいで取りみだしたりはしないさ。ま、座って話そうぜ」
lines.english: “Phew. I know. Just a little joke. I observe restraint and good manners in my hobbies. A thing like this couldn't possibly rattle me. Come on, let's sit and talk.”

lines.japanese: 「おう。そんでコレなんだけどさ──」
lines.english: “Right. So about this stuff—”

lines.japanese: 「──ああ、いくらだ？」
lines.english: “—yeah. How much?”

lines.japanese: 「分かってねえじゃねーか」
lines.english: “You didn’t get it at all!”

lines.japanese: 「違ぇんだよ、コレはヤーさんの手垢が付いてるヤバいもんなの。転売なんかしたら、俺もおまえもタマ狙われちゃうの」
lines.english: “Listen, this shit's got yakuza fingerprints all over it. We try to sell it and they'll come for both our heads.”

lines.japanese: 「ええぇぇ～、なあんだ、そおなのおぉぉぉ～」
lines.english: “Awwww. Really? Is thaaat all?”

lines.japanese: 「急にやる気をなくすな」
lines.english: “Don't lose interest that fast.”

lines.japanese: 「んで聞くけど、どうなのコレ。やっぱ本モンなの」
lines.english: “So tell me. What do you think? Is this the real thing?”

lines.japanese: 「空港の犬じゃあるまいし、そんなの実際食ってみなきゃ分かんないよ」
lines.english: “I'm not an airport dog. You can't know for sure without actually trying it.”

lines.japanese: 「そーなん？　刑事ドラマとかであるじゃん、ほんのちょっとペロッと舐めて『ヤクだ』みたいの」
lines.english: “Really? You see it on cop shows, though. They lick the tiniest bit and go, ‘Drugs.’”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ、あんなのは……」
lines.english: “Hah, that's just—”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　そ、そうね、あるよね、うん、あるある！　じゃじゃじゃじゃあ、俺もほんのちょっと舐めてみるわ。ちょうだいちょうだい、邪念はないよ、味見するだけだよ！」
lines.english: “Oh! R-right, yeah, people do that! Totally! Th-th-then I'll lick just a tiny bit. Gimme, gimme. No ulterior motives. I'm only tasting it!”

lines.japanese: 「なんでそんな目が血走ってンだよ。邪念の塊じゃねーか」
lines.english: “Why are your eyes bloodshot? You're made of ulterior motives.”

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに本モンだったら、どんぐらいの量でキマっちゃうの」
lines.english: “Say it is real. How much would it take to get you high?”

lines.japanese: 「そおね～。ネタにもよるけど、冷たいのを舌下で行くなら、３０ミリかそこらでパッキパキにガンギマれるよね～」
lines.english: “Well, depends on the product, but if you're putting ice under your tongue, thirty milligrams or so will wire you out of your fucking skull.”

lines.japanese: 「専門用語使うな。ぶっちゃけ目分量でどんぐらいなんだよ」
lines.english: “Quit with the jargon. What does that look like?”

lines.japanese: 「ほんのちょっとよ。耳かき一杯もいらない程度」
lines.english: “Barely anything. Less than a scoop from an ear pick.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな微量でかよ。おっかねーな。じゃあ実質、味見なんて出来ないに等しいじゃねえか」
lines.english: “That tiny an amount? Scary shit. So for all practical purposes, you can't taste-test it.”

lines.japanese: 「まあね～、ドラマはドラマだから。実際あんなちょびっとでも舐めちゃったら、お巡りさんパッキパキにガンギマっちゃうもんね～！」
lines.english: “Pretty much. TV's TV. Even that little lick would have the cop wired out of his fucking skull!”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど、ひとつ勉強になった」
lines.english: “Huh. Learned something new.”

lines.japanese: 「ってわけで帰る。じゃあな」
lines.english: “Which means I'm leaving. See ya.”

lines.japanese: 「ええええっ！？　なんでえ～！　味見は～！」
lines.english: “Whaaat?! Why? What about the taste test?”

lines.japanese: こいつ、三馬鹿の中じゃいちばんアタマはまともだと思ってたけど、やっぱアホだわ。
lines.english: I'd thought he was the most sensible of the three idiots, but no. Still an idiot.

lines.japanese: 「クク、独り占めは許さないぜ、成田チャンよ……フウゥー……」
lines.english: “Heh heh. I won't let you keep it all to yourself, Narita... Hoooo...”

lines.japanese: やつは俺の行く手に周りこむと、奇妙な構えを取った。
lines.english: He circled around to block my path and assumed a strange stance.

lines.japanese: 「あっれえ隼人先輩、来てたんスかあ！　え、なになに、チケドンさんと試合！？」
lines.english: “Oh, hey, Hayato! When'd you get here? Wait, what? You're fighting Chikedon?”

lines.japanese: 「マジかよ成田君、虚勢されたチワワみたいに謙虚なこと言いやがって、本当は戦闘意欲ドーベルマンだったとは恐れいるぜ」
lines.english: “Jesus, Narita. You talked humble as a neutered Chihuahua, but inside you were a Doberman spoiling for a fight. Consider me impressed.”

lines.japanese: 「うーるーせ、やんねえよ。もう帰るっつってんだろ。どけオラ」
lines.english: “Shut up. I'm not fighting. I'm leaving, so move.”

lines.japanese: 「ノーマン！　お断る！」
lines.english: “No, man! Request denied!”

lines.japanese: 「ここはすでにマットなきリング！　口で語るな、こぶしで語れ！　何故ならば、何故ならば俺たちは男の子！　男の道はこぶしで作る、塞がる壁はこぶしで崩す、欲しいものならこぶしで奪う！」
lines.english: “This is already a ring without a mat! Speak with your fists, not your mouth! Why? Because—because we are boys! A man's road is built with fists, the walls in his way fall to fists, and whatever he desires he seizes with fists!”

lines.japanese: 「え……ちょーちょー、なんだよ、なんで続々と野次馬が集まってくンだよ。やんねえよ、散れ散れ、解散」
lines.english: “Wait, wait. Why are spectators coming out of the woodwork? I'm not doing this. Beat it. Show's over.”

lines.japanese: 「へいへい、ピッチャーびびってるー。チケドンさん、勝てる勝てるー」
lines.english: “Hey, hey, the pitcher's scared! You got this, Chikedon!”

lines.japanese: 「イェア！　やっちまえチケドン、相手はしおれた海綿体だ！」
lines.english: “Yeah! Get him, Chikedon! He's nothing but a wilted corpus cavernosum!”

lines.japanese: 「チェストォォォ──！」
lines.english: “Hyaaaaaah!”
“Whoa...”

lines.japanese: やべえ。こいつの手刀、意外に速ええ。遊んでる余裕はないかもしれ──
lines.english: Shit. His knife-hand strike was faster than I'd expected. I might not have room to screw around—

lines.japanese: 「シェ！　シェア！　シェアアアー！」
lines.english: “Sha! Shaya! Shayaaaa!”

lines.japanese: 厄介なコンビネーションの三段目を読みきれなかった。手首に痛烈なしびれが走り、俺は荷物を取りおとしていた。
lines.english: I failed to read the third strike in his annoying combination. A vicious shock ran through my wrist, and I dropped the bag.

lines.japanese: 「もらったあァァァー！」
lines.english: “Mine!”
“Shit...!”

lines.japanese: レゲエ野郎が膝のバネを利かせて飛びこんできた。俺はガードを上げて頭をかばう。
lines.english: The reggae guy sprang at me on bent knees. I brought up my guard to protect my head.

lines.japanese: しかし──
lines.english: But—

lines.japanese: 「もーらい♪」
lines.english: “Miiine!”

lines.japanese: ──やつがもらったのは俺の隙ではなく、俺の足元に落ちたバッグだった。
lines.english: —what he seized wasn't my opening. It was the bag at my feet.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿か」
lines.english: “Are you stupid?”

lines.japanese: ツッコミ感覚で、思わず無抵抗の相手を蹴りたおしてしまった。
lines.english: The straight-man reflex took over, and I kicked down my completely defenseless opponent.

lines.japanese: 「あでっ」
lines.english: “Ow!”

lines.japanese: やつは胸にバッグを抱いたままゴロンと仰向けに転がった。
lines.english: Still clutching the bag to his chest, he rolled onto his back.

lines.japanese: その瞬間、店じゅうにゴングの音が鳴りひびいた。
lines.english: At that moment, the sound of a gong rang through the entire club.
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、青天！　チケドンさんが青天された！　ありえない、そんな馬鹿な……」
lines.english: “H-he’s flat on his back! Chikedon’s been laid out! Impossible! That’s just stupid...”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、そんな馬鹿だったからな」
lines.english: “Well, he was that stupid.”

lines.japanese: 「ホーリーシッ！　あのチケドンをいとも容易くひっくり返すなんて、なんという恐ろしい攻撃だ……」
lines.english: “Holy shit! You flipped Chikedon over with such ease. What a terrifying attack...”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、単なるツッコミだけどな」
lines.english: “It was just a straight-man kick.”

lines.japanese: 「くっそおおおお、集中力には定評があるこの俺の、いったいどこに隙があったって言うんだ！」
lines.english: “Damn it! My powers of concentration are legendary. Where could I possibly have left an opening?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、隙しかなかったけどな」
lines.english: “You were nothing but openings.”

lines.japanese: 「フッ、だが負けは負けだ。みんな！　卑劣な小細工で勝利をもぎとった貪欲な勝者に、俺たちはスポーツマンらしく拍手で応えようじゃないか」
lines.english: “Hmph. But a loss is a loss. Everyone! Let us answer this greedy victor, who stole his win through a cowardly trick, with the applause of true sportsmen!”

lines.japanese: 「おめでとうございます、隼人先輩。決勝戦で会いましょう！」
lines.english: “Congratulations, Hayato. See you in the finals!”

lines.japanese: 「おっと。その前に準決勝で当たるはずの俺様を忘れてもらっちゃあ困るぜ！」
lines.english: “Not so fast. You'd better not forget that you face yours truly in the semifinals first!”

lines.japanese: 「成田チャンよ、おまえはこの俺を倒したんだ、優勝しなかったら承知しないからな！」
lines.english: “Narita, you defeated me. I won't forgive you if you don't win the whole thing!”

lines.japanese: 「はっはっはっはっはっ……」
lines.english: “Hahahahahaha...”

lines.japanese: 「……あれ？　隼人先輩は？」
lines.english: “...Huh? Where'd Hayato go?”
“Haaaah...”

lines.japanese: なにが決勝戦で会いましょうだ、そんな無法者運動会に付きあえるほど俺は若くねえっつーの。
lines.english: *See you in the finals*, my ass. I was too old to waste my time at an outlaw field day like that.

lines.japanese: 呑気な連中だ。知らねーぞ、いきなりガサ入ってパクられたって。鳳の根回しつったって絶対じゃねえだろうに。
lines.english: What a carefree bunch. They'd change their tune if the cops suddenly raided the place and hauled them in. Kakeru might have greased the wheels, but it couldn't be foolproof.

lines.japanese: で、その鳳はどこにいるんだ。不本意だけど、ちょっと電話してみるか。
lines.english: And where was Kakeru, anyway? I didn't love the idea, but maybe I'd call him.

lines.japanese: でもとりあえず場所は変えよう。ここにいたら、またあいつらに捕まる可能性がある。
lines.english: First, though, I needed to go somewhere else. If I stayed here, those idiots might catch me again.
